back: A continent centred on the South Pole, almost entirely south of the Antarctic Circle (about 66.5° S), surrounded by the Southern Ocean.
High latitude and low sun angle, months of polar night, high albedo of snow and ice, high altitude of the ice sheet.
Cold air holds little moisture and sinks under a polar high, so few clouds form; the interior is a polar desert.
The proportion of incoming sunlight a surface reflects; fresh snow has a very high albedo.
Cold, dense air flowing downhill, such as off the Antarctic ice sheet towards the coast.
Phytoplankton → krill → whales, seals, penguins and fish → leopard seals and killer whales.
So many animals depend on it for food that a fall in krill numbers affects the whole food web.
Mainly mosses, lichens and algae; only two flowering plants (a hair grass and a pearlwort), mostly on the Peninsula.
Dense feathers and fat, breeding on sea ice in winter, eggs balanced on the feet, huddling to cut heat loss.
